method: verdict = fail when measured p95 > max (or min sample < min); unmeasured when there are no samples or the threshold is null / status=pending-real-sample. Percentiles are nearest-rank, rounded half-away-from-zero to 3 decimals. See desktop/delivery/MEASUREMENT.md.
rationale: Frozen once, before acceptance, from real measurements taken on 2026-09-09 in D:/Craftmine World-worktrees/godot-remaining-k-20260910 with the pinned Godot 4.7.2-stable cache and the real windows-preview-batch-07 package. Latency limits carry roughly 2-5x headroom over the observed p95 so that normal machine variance does not flip the verdict; size and memory limits carry roughly 1.2-1.7x. No threshold may be widened to make a later failing sample pass.

startup.cold.ms.rationale: First launch in the measurement process (this process has not warmed the package file cache). Observed 149-196 ms in two runs; 1000 ms keeps a user-visible cold-start budget.

startup.warm.ms.rationale: Second launch in the same process. Observed 161-162 ms.

startup.offscreenRendered.ms.rationale: Boot phase window-rendered-offscreen (offscreen compositor first paint). Observed 1407-1568 ms.

waits.engine-import.ms.rationale: Godot headless --import of a fresh scratch copy of the top-down blank world. Observed p95 3004 ms.

waits.project-build.ms.rationale: new-world.mjs materialisation plus engine import. Observed p95 3113 ms.

waits.probe-check.ms.rationale: Full top-down base acceptance script driven through headless probes. Observed p95 23159 ms.

waits.candidate-apply.ms.rationale: No real broker/apply timing is exposed in this tree. A product apply must be executed and captured before a number is frozen.

waits.install.ms.rationale: Installer execution needs a disposable clean Windows VM; not run on this machine.

frame.time.ms.rationale: Per-frame headless engine delta from the real top-down base main scene. 16.67 ms is the 60 fps frame budget; observed p95 6.99 ms over 900 frames.

memory.workingSet.peak.mb.rationale: Root client process working set peak over a 12 s window after readiness. Observed 603 MB.

memory.workingSet.steady.mb.rationale: Root client process working set p50 over the last half of the window. Observed 269 MB.

memory.privateBytes.peak.mb.rationale: Root client process private bytes peak. Observed 557 MB.

memory.privateBytes.steady.mb.rationale: Root client process private bytes p50 over the last half of the window. Observed 222 MB.

memory.treeWorkingSet.peak.mb.rationale: Sum of working set over the whole client process tree (main, renderer, GPU, utility). Observed 1519 MB.

memory.treePrivateBytes.peak.mb.rationale: Sum of private page count over the whole client process tree. Observed 1240 MB.

size.install.total.mb.rationale: Sum of all file bytes in windows-preview-batch-07. Observed 546.6 MB including the NSIS installer.

size.fileCount.rationale: Regular files under the package root. Observed 828 before the pinned Git tree was added; the required MinGit tree adds 385 files plus the bundle record, so the composition measured 1217 and the cap was raised from 1200 to 1400 before acceptance. This is a composition change (R1 requires a bundled Git), not a widening after a failing run: no run had failed on file count.

changeLog.reason: bundled MinGit tree (385 files) is now a required package component

size.resources.other.mb.rationale: resources/* not in a named bucket (app.asar, models.dev, skills). Observed 35.78 MB.

size.resources.git.mb.rationale: resources/git, the pinned MinGit tree that R1's managed Git requires (385 files, 109.06 MB measured from the official archive). Added before acceptance as a required component with its own bucket so the total install size stays the governing limit.

size.exe-dll.mb.rationale: Root executables and DLLs excluding the NSIS installer. Observed 300.67 MB.

size.other.mb.rationale: Package files outside the named buckets. Observed 0 MB.

git.log.ms.rationale: git log --oneline -n 500 over 30 samples in this repository. Observed p95 81.6 ms.

git.log.cold.ms.rationale: First git log in the measurement process. Observed 57.4 ms.

git.log.warm.ms.rationale: Subsequent git log runs. Observed p95 81.6 ms.

git.diffStat.ms.rationale: git diff --stat HEAD~50..HEAD over 30 samples. Observed p95 236.4 ms.

git.diffStat.cold.ms.rationale: First git diff in the measurement process; includes cold object reads. Observed 481.3 ms.

git.diffStat.warm.ms.rationale: Subsequent git diff runs. Observed p95 200.6 ms.

git.largeFileDiff.ms.rationale: git diff of the largest file changed in HEAD~50..HEAD. Observed p95 44.5 ms.

git.largeFileDiff.cold.ms.rationale: First large-file diff in the measurement process. Observed 39.2 ms.

git.largeFileDiff.warm.ms.rationale: Subsequent large-file diff runs. Observed p95 44.5 ms.

assets.search.ms.rationale: AL2 asset catalog search is not integrated in this tree (vendor/pi-desktop/crates/craftmine-core/src/asset_catalog/ absent). No product number may be frozen from the synthetic index.

assets.preview.ms.rationale: AL2 asset preview is not integrated in this tree. No product number may be frozen from the synthetic index.

product.hello.ms.rationale: Round trip of the real craftmine-core.exe hello handshake. Measured against a task branch build only; no integrated product build exists yet, so no threshold may be frozen.

product.gitInfo.ms.rationale: R1 content.gitInfo round trip (managed Git discovery). The R1 adapter is not registered in an integrated build, so the number is calibration, not acceptance.

product.assetSearch.ms.rationale: R6 asset.search round trip over an empty catalog. R6 is not registered in an integrated build, so the number is calibration, not acceptance.

assets.preview.synthetic-1000.ms.rationale: Synthetic in-memory preview tier 1000; not product acceptance.

assets.search.synthetic-10000.ms.rationale: Synthetic in-memory index tier 10000; exercises percentile math and the tier, not product acceptance.
